newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk zinc producer reports profit, higher output.
newsitem.headline: Turk zinc producer reports profit, higher output.

text.p: Turkey's Cinkur Zinc-Lead Metal Industry Inc, privatised last year, reported a profit of 33.8 billion lira ($244,000) last year and lowered unit costs.
"The company closed last year's balance sheet with a profit of 33.8 billion lira although it was operating at a loss before the privatisation," it said in a statement.
The government had sold its shares to Kayseri Maden Metal Ticaret A.S. in May 1996 as part of its privatisation drive.

"While the annual production of zinc metal was 18,000-20,000 tonnes before the privatisation, it increased to the level of 30,000-35,000 tonnes within the first year of operation. The level of unit costs has been decreased from $1,500 per tonne to $1,250 in the same period," the company said.
The company exported $11.1 million worth of zinc metal, 30 percent of its total production, in the past 12 months.

"Production of Special High Grade zinc metal has started already and the registration formalities of this product to the London Metal Exchange are expected to be completed within this year," the statement said. ($ = 138320 Turkish Lire)
